docs.summary: The scroll view's live viewport, handed to the [`Body`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.ScrollViewBuilder~Body) callback. Content is offset by ([`ScrollX`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.ScrollViewport~ScrollX), [`ScrollY`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.ScrollViewport~ScrollY)); [`Width`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.ScrollViewport~Width) / [`Height`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.ScrollViewport~Height) are the visible inner area (padding and any scrollbar already subtracted). Use these to virtualize long lists: render only the rows intersecting [ScrollY, ScrollY+Height].
